contractVersion.description: Strict semver contract version carried by every wire object. Decoders accept the same major version; any other version is a typed error.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with millisecond precision, `Z` suffix only.

derivationId.description: Opaque stable identifier assigned by the authority that owns the object.

items.description: sha-256 content address (64 lowercase hex). Normative derivation: the frozen AISE-CONTENT-V1 canonical encoding (see apps/android ContentIdentity).

method.description: Provider-neutral method identity, e.g. `reconstruction.worldsculpt`. No engine is an authority; outputs are candidates until AISE gates accept them.

outputContentId.description: Content address of the derived artifact (derived outputs are content-addressed too).

parameters.description: Deterministic parameters as an inspectable string map.
